title: CHECK IS SIX SMALL TESTS — NOT ONE MAGIC VERDICT
question: What does eval-evidence check actually do?
takeaway: Check turns a run directory into six inspectable operations and reports exactly which scoped test passed or failed.

reading_speeds.at_2_seconds: A run passes through six visible gates before a report appears.
reading_speeds.at_20_seconds: Discovery, parsing, provenance mapping, schema/digest validation, local file re-hashing, and reporting are separate operations.
reading_speeds.at_2_minutes: The report boundary distinguishes current structural and byte-identity checks from runner authenticity, score truth, and model comparability.

medium.rationale: The exact gate order, pass/fail branches, and non-claims must remain unambiguous in code review and CI.

labels.claim: Check discovers supported run roots with the chosen or auto-detected adapter.
The adapter loads required JSON objects and rejects malformed inputs.
Normalized evidence fields retain status and source provenance.
The in-memory bundle is checked against its schema and embedded bundle digest.
Referenced paths are resolved safely and their presence, size, and SHA-256 are compared.
Check emits validity, coverage, errors, warnings, and scoped summary counts.
No requested structural, digest, referenced-file, or coverage-policy check failed now.
At least one scoped check or requested coverage policy failed, with errors reported.
The green boundary lists the facts check inspects in the current run.
The red boundary lists authenticity, truth, and comparability claims outside check scope.

boundaries: Check does not write a stored baseline.
Check runs no model and does not authenticate a runner.
Evidence coverage is not a comparability or claim-readiness score.

accessibility.alt_text: Eval Evidence check passes a run through six explicit gates: discover, read, label provenance, validate record, re-hash local files, and report pass or fail with reasons.
accessibility.long_description: Six numbered cards run left to right in two rows. The first three find the run, read its files, and label each field. The next three test the record, re-hash local files, and name the result. The final report branches to Pass or Fail plus reason. A bottom proof boundary says what was checked now and what remains unproven.

provenance.method: deterministic SVG from validated semantic brief and paired render manifest
